title: On-chain Wrapped 2023
tagline: On-chain wrapped lets you create a spotify wrapped kind of summary for your wallet address on-chain

prizes.title: Best overall use of Airstack APIs

description:
It gives you a visual summary of your on-chain activity for the year across multiple blockchains and enables you to see the data backing it. 

The on-chain wrapped involves summary across the following
- Number of POAPs collected
- POAP data
- Location where most POAPs were collected
- Chain used the most
- Number of token transfers performed on that chain
- Token used the most on that chain
- Maximum value of the token transferred in a single tx
- Total transfer value of the token
- Lens Followers
- Lens follower data
- Data of all transfers on chain used most
